Act as the Flight Safety responsible engineer during mission rehearsals and live recovery operations. Establish technical safety limits and mission rules for real-time on-console operations. jobs.description_text: About this Role As the Thermal Hardware and Test Engineer II , you will be responsible for hardware design, build, and test for ground and spacecraft thermal and fluid systems. Day-to-day responsibilities will be focused in thermomechanical hardware and system sizing, CAD design, fabrication, testing, instrumentation, and troubleshooting. Successful candidates thrive on solving hard problems, adapting to dynamic requirements, and collaborating across multiple domains. You will gain significant ownership, see your contributions rapidly come to life, and help us uphold the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety in our hardware. If expanding the capability of in-orbit manufacturing to serve life-changing products to patients sounds intriguing, this role is for you. This role is open at the Eng II level, with levels determined based on candidate experience. You will be responsible for defining performance metrics, operational requirements, and hardware requirements for ground testing and flight. Day-to-day responsibilities include sizing thermofluid and system and component performance via hand calculations, simulation, and testing.
